reconstruction.scope: Complete enclosed wooden pavilion exterior at Yasnaya Polyana: compact mapped rectangle, pale mint horizontal siding above a vertical-board dado, steep weathered-gray gable roof with overhangs, vertical-board gables, toothed verge and eave trim, three-part southeast window and single northwest window, triangular attic vents and a recessed northeast side entrance. No invented open gazebo, interior exhibit, copied signs, inscriptions, people or photograph pixels. The unseen door and hidden side inventory are explicitly reconstructed.
